PROGRAM return review

TYPE ReturnStatus is "new" | "approved" | "needs_review"

RECORD ReturnRequest
  days_since_purchase: integer

RECORD ReturnDecision
  status: ReturnStatus
  reason: "new" | "within_window" | "outside_window"

REQUEST review return
  GIVEN item is ReturnRequest

  GIVEN decision is ReturnDecision
    status: "new"
    reason: "new"

  WHEN review item into decision

  OUTPUT decision is ReturnDecision

  THEN decision.status != "new"
  AND decision.reason != "new"

WHEN review <item> into <decision>
  GIVEN item is ReturnRequest
  GIVEN decision is ReturnDecision
  IF item.days_since_purchase <= 30
    set decision.status to "approved"
    set decision.reason to "within_window"
  ELSE
    set decision.status to "needs_review"
    set decision.reason to "outside_window"

SCENARIO approves return on day 30
GIVEN item is ReturnRequest
  days_since_purchase: 30
GIVEN decision is ReturnDecision
  status: "new"
  reason: "new"
WHEN review item into decision
THEN decision.status == "approved"
AND decision.reason == "within_window"

SCENARIO requires review on day 31
GIVEN item is ReturnRequest
  days_since_purchase: 31
GIVEN decision is ReturnDecision
  status: "new"
  reason: "new"
WHEN review item into decision
THEN decision.status == "needs_review"
AND decision.reason == "outside_window"

PROGRAM incident triage

TYPE IncidentSeverity is "normal" | "degraded" | "critical"
TYPE IncidentPriority is "new" | "routine" | "review" | "urgent"

RECORD IncidentRequest
  severity: IncidentSeverity
  customer_outage: boolean

RECORD IncidentDecision
  priority: IncidentPriority
  reason: "new" | "normal_operations" | "degraded_service" | "customer_outage"

REQUEST triage incident
  GIVEN incident is IncidentRequest

  GIVEN decision is IncidentDecision
    priority: "new"
    reason: "new"

  WHEN triage incident into decision

  OUTPUT decision is IncidentDecision

  THEN decision.priority != "new"
  AND decision.reason != "new"

WHEN triage incident into decision
  GIVEN incident is IncidentRequest
  GIVEN incident.customer_outage is true
  GIVEN decision is IncidentDecision
  set decision.priority to "urgent"
  set decision.reason to "customer_outage"

WHEN triage incident into decision
  GIVEN incident is IncidentRequest
  GIVEN incident.customer_outage is false
  GIVEN incident.severity is "critical"
  GIVEN decision is IncidentDecision
  set decision.priority to "urgent"
  set decision.reason to "degraded_service"

WHEN triage incident into decision
  GIVEN incident is IncidentRequest
  GIVEN incident.customer_outage is false
  GIVEN incident.severity is "degraded"
  GIVEN decision is IncidentDecision
  set decision.priority to "review"
  set decision.reason to "degraded_service"

WHEN triage incident into decision
  GIVEN incident is IncidentRequest
  GIVEN incident.customer_outage is false
  GIVEN incident.severity is "normal"
  GIVEN decision is IncidentDecision
  set decision.priority to "routine"
  set decision.reason to "normal_operations"

SCENARIO normal service is routine
GIVEN incident is IncidentRequest
  severity: "normal"
  customer_outage: false
GIVEN decision is IncidentDecision
  priority: "new"
  reason: "new"
WHEN triage incident into decision
THEN decision.priority == "routine"
AND decision.reason == "normal_operations"

SCENARIO degraded service needs review
GIVEN incident is IncidentRequest
  severity: "degraded"
  customer_outage: false
GIVEN decision is IncidentDecision
  priority: "new"
  reason: "new"
WHEN triage incident into decision
THEN decision.priority == "review"
AND decision.reason == "degraded_service"

SCENARIO critical severity is urgent
GIVEN incident is IncidentRequest
  severity: "critical"
  customer_outage: false
GIVEN decision is IncidentDecision
  priority: "new"
  reason: "new"
WHEN triage incident into decision
THEN decision.priority == "urgent"
AND decision.reason == "degraded_service"

SCENARIO customer outage is urgent
GIVEN incident is IncidentRequest
  severity: "normal"
  customer_outage: true
GIVEN decision is IncidentDecision
  priority: "new"
  reason: "new"
WHEN triage incident into decision
THEN decision.priority == "urgent"
AND decision.reason == "customer_outage"

SCENARIO customer outage takes precedence over degraded severity
GIVEN incident is IncidentRequest
  severity: "degraded"
  customer_outage: true
GIVEN decision is IncidentDecision
  priority: "new"
  reason: "new"
WHEN triage incident into decision
THEN decision.priority == "urgent"
AND decision.reason == "customer_outage"

SCENARIO customer outage takes precedence over critical severity
GIVEN incident is IncidentRequest
  severity: "critical"
  customer_outage: true
GIVEN decision is IncidentDecision
  priority: "new"
  reason: "new"
WHEN triage incident into decision
THEN decision.priority == "urgent"
AND decision.reason == "customer_outage"

PROGRAM order fulfillment slice

RECORD FulfillmentRequest
  requested_units: integer
  available_units: integer

RECORD FulfillmentDecision
  status: "new" | "fulfilled" | "partial" | "backordered"
  reserved_units: integer
  backordered_units: integer

REQUEST fulfill order
  GIVEN order is FulfillmentRequest

  GIVEN fulfillment is FulfillmentDecision
    status: "new"
    reserved_units: 0
    backordered_units: 0

  WHEN fulfill order into fulfillment

  OUTPUT fulfillment is FulfillmentDecision

  THEN fulfillment.status != "new"

WHEN fulfill <order> into <fulfillment>
  GIVEN order.requested_units <= order.available_units
  set fulfillment.status to "fulfilled"
  set fulfillment.reserved_units to order.requested_units
  set fulfillment.backordered_units to 0

WHEN fulfill <order> into <fulfillment>
  GIVEN order.available_units > 0
  GIVEN order.available_units < order.requested_units
  set fulfillment.status to "partial"
  set fulfillment.reserved_units to order.available_units
  set fulfillment.backordered_units to order.requested_units - order.available_units

WHEN fulfill <order> into <fulfillment>
  GIVEN order.available_units == 0
  set fulfillment.status to "backordered"
  set fulfillment.reserved_units to 0
  set fulfillment.backordered_units to order.requested_units

SCENARIO fulfills every requested unit when stock is sufficient
GIVEN order is FulfillmentRequest
  requested_units: 5
  available_units: 5
GIVEN fulfillment is FulfillmentDecision
  status: "new"
  reserved_units: 0
  backordered_units: 0
WHEN fulfill order into fulfillment
THEN fulfillment.status == "fulfilled"
THEN fulfillment.reserved_units == 5
THEN fulfillment.backordered_units == 0

SCENARIO partially fulfills when some stock exists
GIVEN order is FulfillmentRequest
  requested_units: 5
  available_units: 2
GIVEN fulfillment is FulfillmentDecision
  status: "new"
  reserved_units: 0
  backordered_units: 0
WHEN fulfill order into fulfillment
THEN fulfillment.status == "partial"
THEN fulfillment.reserved_units == 2
THEN fulfillment.backordered_units == 3

SCENARIO backorders every unit when no stock exists
GIVEN order is FulfillmentRequest
  requested_units: 5
  available_units: 0
GIVEN fulfillment is FulfillmentDecision
  status: "new"
  reserved_units: 0
  backordered_units: 0
WHEN fulfill order into fulfillment
THEN fulfillment.status == "backordered"
THEN fulfillment.reserved_units == 0
THEN fulfillment.backordered_units == 5

PROGRAM funding eligibility slice

RECORD FundingFacts
  cohort_funded: boolean
  previously_funded: boolean
  institution_eligible: boolean

RECORD FundingDecision
  outcome: "new" | "funded" | "not_funded"
  reason: "new" | "unfunded_cohort" | "previously_funded" | "eligible" | "ineligible_institution"

REQUEST assess funding
  GIVEN facts is FundingFacts

  GIVEN decision is FundingDecision
    outcome: "new"
    reason: "new"

  WHEN assess facts into decision

  OUTPUT decision is FundingDecision

  THEN decision.outcome != "new"
  AND decision.reason != "new"

WHEN assess <facts> into <decision>
  GIVEN facts.cohort_funded == false
  set decision.outcome to "not_funded"
  set decision.reason to "unfunded_cohort"

WHEN assess <facts> into <decision>
  GIVEN facts.cohort_funded == true
  AND facts.previously_funded == true
  set decision.outcome to "not_funded"
  set decision.reason to "previously_funded"

WHEN assess <facts> into <decision>
  GIVEN facts.cohort_funded == true
  AND facts.previously_funded == false
  AND facts.institution_eligible == true
  set decision.outcome to "funded"
  set decision.reason to "eligible"

WHEN assess <facts> into <decision>
  GIVEN facts.cohort_funded == true
  AND facts.previously_funded == false
  AND facts.institution_eligible == false
  set decision.outcome to "not_funded"
  set decision.reason to "ineligible_institution"

SCENARIO unfunded cohort takes precedence
GIVEN facts is FundingFacts
  cohort_funded: false
  previously_funded: true
  institution_eligible: true

REQUEST assess funding

THEN decision.outcome == "not_funded"
AND decision.reason == "unfunded_cohort"

SCENARIO previous funding takes precedence over institution eligibility
GIVEN facts is FundingFacts
  cohort_funded: true
  previously_funded: true
  institution_eligible: true

REQUEST assess funding

THEN decision.outcome == "not_funded"
AND decision.reason == "previously_funded"

SCENARIO eligible institution receives funding
GIVEN facts is FundingFacts
  cohort_funded: true
  previously_funded: false
  institution_eligible: true

REQUEST assess funding

THEN decision.outcome == "funded"
AND decision.reason == "eligible"

SCENARIO ineligible institution is not funded
GIVEN facts is FundingFacts
  cohort_funded: true
  previously_funded: false
  institution_eligible: false

REQUEST assess funding

THEN decision.outcome == "not_funded"
AND decision.reason == "ineligible_institution"

PROGRAM semantic release slice

RECORD CommitFacts
  breaking_change: boolean
  feature: boolean
  fix: boolean

RECORD ReleaseDecision
  level: "new" | "major" | "minor" | "patch" | "none"

REQUEST analyze commit
  GIVEN commit is CommitFacts

  GIVEN release is ReleaseDecision
    level: "new"

  WHEN analyze commit into release

  OUTPUT release is ReleaseDecision

  THEN release.level != "new"

WHEN analyze commit into release
  GIVEN commit is CommitFacts
  GIVEN release is ReleaseDecision
  IF commit.breaking_change
    set release.level to "major"
  ELSE IF commit.feature
    set release.level to "minor"
  ELSE IF commit.fix
    set release.level to "patch"
  ELSE
    set release.level to "none"

SCENARIO breaking changes take precedence over features and fixes
GIVEN commit is CommitFacts
  breaking_change: true
  feature: true
  fix: true
GIVEN release is ReleaseDecision
  level: "new"
WHEN analyze commit into release
THEN release.level == "major"

SCENARIO features take precedence over fixes
GIVEN commit is CommitFacts
  breaking_change: false
  feature: true
  fix: true
GIVEN release is ReleaseDecision
  level: "new"
WHEN analyze commit into release
THEN release.level == "minor"

SCENARIO fixes produce a patch release
GIVEN commit is CommitFacts
  breaking_change: false
  feature: false
  fix: true
GIVEN release is ReleaseDecision
  level: "new"
WHEN analyze commit into release
THEN release.level == "patch"

SCENARIO irrelevant commits produce no release
GIVEN commit is CommitFacts
  breaking_change: false
  feature: false
  fix: false
GIVEN release is ReleaseDecision
  level: "new"
WHEN analyze commit into release
THEN release.level == "none"

WHEN approve <decision>
  set decision to "approved"

SCENARIO approval uses the domain behavior
GIVEN decision is "new"
WHEN approve decision
THEN decision == "approved"

WHEN mark known item from <items> into <result>
  FIND item in items WHERE item == "known"
    set result to item
  ELSE
    set result to "missing"

SCENARIO known item is selected
GIVEN items is ["known"]
GIVEN result is "missing"
WHEN mark known item from items into result
THEN result == "known"

SCENARIO missing item remains missing
GIVEN items is []
GIVEN result is "missing"
WHEN mark known item from items into result
THEN result == "missing"

WHEN record waiting <days> into <total>
  GIVEN days is integer
  AND total is integer
  add days to total

SCENARIO waiting days are counted
GIVEN days is 5
GIVEN total is 0
WHEN record waiting days into total
THEN total == 5

RECORD Applicant
  name: text
  referral: optional<text>

WHEN classify <applicant> into <status>
  GIVEN applicant is Applicant
  IF applicant.referral is present
    IF applicant.referral == "trusted"
      set status to "approved"
    ELSE
      set status to "review"
  ELSE
    set status to "review"

SCENARIO missing referral requires review
GIVEN applicant is Applicant
  name: "Ada"
GIVEN status is "new"
WHEN classify applicant into status
THEN status == "review"

TYPE ReviewState is "new"

RECORD Review
  status: ReviewState

SCENARIO review begins new
GIVEN review is Review
  status: "new"
THEN review.status == "new"

WHEN approve <decision>
  set decision to "approved"

SCENARIO approval changes the decision
GIVEN decision is "new"
WHEN approve decision
THEN decision == "approved"

PROGRAM incident triage

TYPE IncidentSeverity is "normal" | "degraded" | "critical"
TYPE IncidentPriority is "new" | "routine" | "review" | "urgent"

RECORD IncidentRequest
  severity: IncidentSeverity
  customer_outage: boolean

RECORD IncidentDecision
  priority: IncidentPriority
  reason: "new" | "normal_operations" | "degraded_service" | "customer_outage"

REQUEST triage incident
  GIVEN incident is IncidentRequest

  GIVEN decision is IncidentDecision
    priority: "new"
    reason: "new"

  WHEN triage incident into decision

  OUTPUT decision is IncidentDecision

  THEN decision.priority != "new"
  AND decision.reason != "new"

WHEN triage incident into <decision>
  GIVEN incident is IncidentRequest
  GIVEN decision is IncidentDecision
  IF incident.customer_outage is true
    set decision.priority to "urgent"
    set decision.reason to "customer_outage"
  ELSE IF incident.severity is "critical"
    set decision.priority to "urgent"
    set decision.reason to "degraded_service"
  ELSE IF incident.severity is "degraded"
    set decision.priority to "review"
    set decision.reason to "degraded_service"
  ELSE
    set decision.priority to "routine"
    set decision.reason to "normal_operations"

SCENARIO normal service is routine
GIVEN incident is IncidentRequest
  severity: "normal"
  customer_outage: false
GIVEN decision is IncidentDecision
  priority: "new"
  reason: "new"
WHEN triage incident into decision
THEN decision.priority == "routine"
AND decision.reason == "normal_operations"

SCENARIO degraded service needs review
GIVEN incident is IncidentRequest
  severity: "degraded"
  customer_outage: false
GIVEN decision is IncidentDecision
  priority: "new"
  reason: "new"
WHEN triage incident into decision
THEN decision.priority == "review"
AND decision.reason == "degraded_service"

SCENARIO critical severity is urgent
GIVEN incident is IncidentRequest
  severity: "critical"
  customer_outage: false
GIVEN decision is IncidentDecision
  priority: "new"
  reason: "new"
WHEN triage incident into decision
THEN decision.priority == "urgent"
AND decision.reason == "degraded_service"

SCENARIO customer outage is urgent
GIVEN incident is IncidentRequest
  severity: "normal"
  customer_outage: true
GIVEN decision is IncidentDecision
  priority: "new"
  reason: "new"
WHEN triage incident into decision
THEN decision.priority == "urgent"
AND decision.reason == "customer_outage"

SCENARIO customer outage takes precedence over degraded severity
GIVEN incident is IncidentRequest
  severity: "degraded"
  customer_outage: true
GIVEN decision is IncidentDecision
  priority: "new"
  reason: "new"
WHEN triage incident into decision
THEN decision.priority == "urgent"
AND decision.reason == "customer_outage"

SCENARIO customer outage takes precedence over critical severity
GIVEN incident is IncidentRequest
  severity: "critical"
  customer_outage: true
GIVEN decision is IncidentDecision
  priority: "new"
  reason: "new"
WHEN triage incident into decision
THEN decision.priority == "urgent"
AND decision.reason == "customer_outage"

PROGRAM order fulfillment slice

RECORD FulfillmentRequest
  requested_units: integer
  available_units: integer

RECORD FulfillmentDecision
  status: "new" | "fulfilled" | "partial" | "backordered"
  reserved_units: integer
  backordered_units: integer

REQUEST fulfill order
  GIVEN order is FulfillmentRequest

  GIVEN fulfillment is FulfillmentDecision
    status: "new"
    reserved_units: 0
    backordered_units: 0

  WHEN fulfill order into fulfillment

  OUTPUT fulfillment is FulfillmentDecision

  THEN fulfillment.status != "new"

WHEN fulfill <order> into <fulfillment>
  GIVEN order is FulfillmentRequest
  GIVEN fulfillment is FulfillmentDecision
  IF order.requested_units <= order.available_units
    set fulfillment.status to "fulfilled"
    set fulfillment.reserved_units to order.requested_units
    set fulfillment.backordered_units to 0
  ELSE IF order.available_units > 0
    set fulfillment.status to "partial"
    set fulfillment.reserved_units to order.available_units
    set fulfillment.backordered_units to order.requested_units - order.available_units
  ELSE
    set fulfillment.status to "backordered"
    set fulfillment.reserved_units to 0
    set fulfillment.backordered_units to order.requested_units

SCENARIO fulfills every requested unit when stock is sufficient
GIVEN order is FulfillmentRequest
  requested_units: 5
  available_units: 5
GIVEN fulfillment is FulfillmentDecision
  status: "new"
  reserved_units: 0
  backordered_units: 0
WHEN fulfill order into fulfillment
THEN fulfillment.status == "fulfilled"
THEN fulfillment.reserved_units == 5
THEN fulfillment.backordered_units == 0

SCENARIO partially fulfills when some stock exists
GIVEN order is FulfillmentRequest
  requested_units: 5
  available_units: 2
GIVEN fulfillment is FulfillmentDecision
  status: "new"
  reserved_units: 0
  backordered_units: 0
WHEN fulfill order into fulfillment
THEN fulfillment.status == "partial"
THEN fulfillment.reserved_units == 2
THEN fulfillment.backordered_units == 3

SCENARIO backorders every unit when no stock exists
GIVEN order is FulfillmentRequest
  requested_units: 5
  available_units: 0
GIVEN fulfillment is FulfillmentDecision
  status: "new"
  reserved_units: 0
  backordered_units: 0
WHEN fulfill order into fulfillment
THEN fulfillment.status == "backordered"
THEN fulfillment.reserved_units == 0
THEN fulfillment.backordered_units == 5

PROGRAM funding eligibility slice

RECORD FundingFacts
  cohort_funded: boolean
  previously_funded: boolean
  institution_eligible: boolean

RECORD FundingDecision
  outcome: "new" | "funded" | "not_funded"
  reason: "new" | "unfunded_cohort" | "previously_funded" | "eligible" | "ineligible_institution"

REQUEST assess funding
  GIVEN facts is FundingFacts

  GIVEN decision is FundingDecision
    outcome: "new"
    reason: "new"

  WHEN assess facts into decision

  OUTPUT decision is FundingDecision

  THEN decision.outcome != "new"
  AND decision.reason != "new"

WHEN assess <facts> into <decision>
  GIVEN facts is FundingFacts
  GIVEN decision is FundingDecision
  GIVEN facts.cohort_funded == false
  set decision.outcome to "not_funded"
  set decision.reason to "unfunded_cohort"

WHEN assess <facts> into <decision>
  GIVEN facts is FundingFacts
  GIVEN decision is FundingDecision
  GIVEN facts.cohort_funded == true
  GIVEN facts.previously_funded == true
  set decision.outcome to "not_funded"
  set decision.reason to "previously_funded"

WHEN assess <facts> into <decision>
  GIVEN facts is FundingFacts
  GIVEN decision is FundingDecision
  GIVEN facts.cohort_funded == true
  GIVEN facts.previously_funded == false
  GIVEN facts.institution_eligible == true
  set decision.outcome to "funded"
  set decision.reason to "eligible"

WHEN assess <facts> into <decision>
  GIVEN facts is FundingFacts
  GIVEN decision is FundingDecision
  GIVEN facts.cohort_funded == true
  GIVEN facts.previously_funded == false
  GIVEN facts.institution_eligible == false
  set decision.outcome to "not_funded"
  set decision.reason to "ineligible_institution"

SCENARIO unfunded cohort takes precedence
GIVEN facts is FundingFacts
  cohort_funded: false
  previously_funded: true
  institution_eligible: true

REQUEST assess funding

THEN decision.outcome == "not_funded"
AND decision.reason == "unfunded_cohort"

SCENARIO previous funding takes precedence over institution eligibility
GIVEN facts is FundingFacts
  cohort_funded: true
  previously_funded: true
  institution_eligible: true

REQUEST assess funding

THEN decision.outcome == "not_funded"
AND decision.reason == "previously_funded"

SCENARIO eligible institution receives funding
GIVEN facts is FundingFacts
  cohort_funded: true
  previously_funded: false
  institution_eligible: true

REQUEST assess funding

THEN decision.outcome == "funded"
AND decision.reason == "eligible"

SCENARIO ineligible institution is not funded
GIVEN facts is FundingFacts
  cohort_funded: true
  previously_funded: false
  institution_eligible: false

REQUEST assess funding

THEN decision.outcome == "not_funded"
AND decision.reason == "ineligible_institution"
